how.title: How it Works
how.subtitle: Simple, fast, revolutionary.
how.c_step1_desc: Our system first selects the closest and highest-rated artisan. If they are not available within 5 hours, we expand the search to guarantee the best at 0 KM.
how.c_step2_desc: No improvised profiles. Every professional receives an initial score from the administration after strict checks. Reputation then grows with real reviews.
how.c_step3_desc: Receive exactly 5 high-quality quotes. The perfect number to compare professionalism and price without wasting time in hundreds of confusing offers.
how.p_step1_desc: No monthly subscription. Load credits and spend them only to unlock jobs that really interest you.
how.p_step2_desc: Receive detailed requests thanks to Triage. See the description immediately before spending your credits.
how.p_step3_desc: A dedicated dashboard to manage appointments, messages, and payments in one place.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answered the most common doubts of our users.
faq.more_q: Have more questions? Check the section
faq.c_q1: How much does it cost to post a request?
faq.c_a1: For the client, it's always 100% free. No commission on the work done or fixed registration fees.
faq.c_a2: It's our assistance system. It guides the client step-by-step to provide the professional with all the necessary technical information, reducing useless inspections.
faq.c_a3: Absolutely not. To protect your privacy, contacts are visible only to the professional whose quote or contact request you have accepted.
faq.c_q4: How do I choose the right quote?
faq.c_a4: You will receive up to 5 free quotes. You can compare prices, reviews of professionals, and timing to choose the best offer.
faq.p_a1: You send the quote freezing the tokens. If the client chooses you, the tokens are deducted. If they choose another, you get an immediate refund. You only pay if you are chosen!
faq.p_q2: Can I register without a VAT number?
faq.p_a2: Yes! We also support occasional services. Anyone with certified skills can sign up and start working following current regulations.
faq.p_q3: Do I have to pay monthly subscriptions?
faq.p_a3: No, no fixed costs. You pay only and exclusively if the client accepts your quote and you manage to get the job.
faq.p_a4: They are real and guaranteed. They can only be released by the client after the quote has been assigned to you via the platform.
